card.name: Modifier before a noun in general prose
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words such as a, royal, respective, there, master or living in general web text about history and politics.

modes.label: Scattered modifiers
modes.description: Adjectives or articles just before an expected noun in history or politics prose.
modes.example: When we citizens of the United States elect<< a>> majority, we want it to govern.

card.plain: It reacts to a mix of unrelated words in general writing, so no useful pattern stands out.
